description: Frontend: extend the characters import modal with Upload File / D&D Beyond URL / PDF tabs, add the FormDescriptor-driven ImportReviewPanel that seeds from mappedFields via the schema-id<->ApplyMapping-path bridge table, wire the new API calls + TS types, and add the game-systems previewCharacterForm method. Depends on FEAT-001 (SourceImportResponse / extended review DTO shape) and FEAT-003 (dndbeyond-url endpoint). Last feature; integrates against the whole backend.
steps: Read context.json and the design note sections 'Frontend files to CREATE / MODIFY', 'Review step - FormDescriptor load path', and the DTO shapes on SourceImportResponse / CharacterFieldReviewDto. Match the existing Tailwind token style and the existing api.ts/store.ts patterns (HTTP via @/shared/api/client).

MODIFY src/frontend/aircane-web/src/features/characters/api.ts and store.ts: add importCharacterFromSource(request, { source?, gameSystemDefinitionId? }) -> POST /api/characters/import (raw JSON in canonicalJson; gameSystem/ruleset blank; ?source only on override; gameSystemDefinitionId as query or DTO member) and importCharacterFromDndBeyondUrl({ characterUrl, gameSystemDefinitionId?, campaignId? }) -> POST /api/characters/import/dndbeyond-url. Add TS types: SourceImportResponse { detectedSource, confidence, requiresSourceConfirmation, ruleset, rulesetRequiresConfirmation, review }; extend CharacterFieldReviewDto with review-scoped fields only { gameSystemDefinitionId, mappedFields, requiresGameSystemSelection }; add UnmappedFieldDto.requiresReview; add gameSystemDefinitionId? to ImportCharacterJsonRequest.

MODIFY src/frontend/aircane-web/src/features/characters/components/ImportCharacterModal.vue: three tabs Upload File | D&D Beyond URL | PDF. Upload File: .json picker -> importCharacterFromSource; show detected-source badge; on requiresSourceConfirmation show a source dropdown (Auto-detect, Pathbuilder 2e, D&D Beyond (File), Foundry VTT (D&D 5e), Foundry VTT (PF2e), Roll20, Generic VTT) and re-POST with ?source; on requiresGameSystemSelection show a game-system picker and re-POST with the chosen gameSystemDefinitionId AND the originally detected ?source (pins the mapper). D&D Beyond URL: URL input (placeholder https://www.dndbeyond.com/characters/...), help text linking https://www.dndbeyond.com/account/sharing, disclaimer 'Uses an unofficial API - may not always work. Use PDF export as fallback.', Import -> importCharacterFromDndBeyondUrl. PDF tab unchanged. Badge colors: PathbuilderTwo orange, DndBeyond* red, Foundry* purple, Roll20 blue, GenericVtt gray, Unknown amber.

CREATE src/frontend/aircane-web/src/features/characters/components/ImportReviewPanel.vue: receives the whole SourceImportResponse. Loads the FormDescriptor via previewCharacterForm(response.review.gameSystemDefinitionId); seeds values from response.review.mappedFields (ApplyMapping paths) using a small static schema-id<->ApplyMapping-path bridge table local to the panel (name<->identity.name, str<->abilities.strength, dex<->abilities.dexterity, con<->abilities.constitution, int<->abilities.intelligence, wis<->abilities.wisdom, cha<->abilities.charisma, ac<->combat.armorClass, hp_max<->combat.maxHitPoints, hp_current<->combat.hitPoints, class<->class, level<->level, race<->identity.raceOrAncestry, background<->identity.background); highlights response.review requiresReview + unmapped fields; shows a read-only 'Imported from: [badge]' header bound from response.detectedSource. For D&D 5e render an editable 2014/2024 ruleset dropdown pre-populated with response.ruleset, amber-highlighted with a confirm tooltip when response.rulesetRequiresConfirmation. On confirm, synthesize FieldMappingEntry[] from the (possibly user-edited) mapped values and submit via the EXISTING applyFieldMappings (PUT /api/characters/{id}/field-mappings): each entry sets sourceFieldName to the mapped path or source label (MEDIUM-2), canonicalFieldPath to the ApplyMapping path, value to the edited string. Fields with no ApplyMapping path render read-only from unmappedFields and are NOT submitted.

Add frontend unit tests under src/frontend/aircane-web/src/features/characters/components/__tests__/: ImportCharacterModal.test.ts (tab switching, badge rendering per source, source + game-system confirmation dropdowns, DDB URL submit path with api client mocked) and ImportReviewPanel.test.ts (seeds the renderer from mappedFields via the bridge table, read-only 'Imported from' header, D&D 5e ruleset dropdown + amber confirm highlight, confirm builds well-formed FieldMappingEntry[] with sourceFieldName set).
Run the frontend build (typecheck) and vitest from src/frontend/aircane-web; fix failures; commit locally on the branch (no push).
acceptance_criteria: cd src/frontend/aircane-web && npm run build succeeds (TypeScript typecheck passes).
cd src/frontend/aircane-web && npx vitest run passes, including the new ImportCharacterModal and ImportReviewPanel tests.
The confirm flow constructs FieldMappingEntry objects with sourceFieldName set to a non-null label (MEDIUM-2) so the submission is well-formed.
Source/confidence/ruleset UI binds from response.*; form id / seeded values / system-selection prompt bind from response.review.*.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (npm run build / vue-tsc typecheck 0 errors; npx vitest run 317 pass across 45 files, including the 13 new tests). FEAT-004 is the frontend; no backend changes.

FILES CREATED:
- src/features/characters/components/ImportReviewPanel.vue: receives the WHOLE SourceImportResponse (prop `response`). onMounted loads the FormDescriptor via previewCharacterForm(response.review.gameSystemDefinitionId) and seeds a schema-field-id-keyed model from response.review.mappedFields (ApplyMapping paths) using the LOCAL static SCHEMA_ID_TO_PATH bridge table (name<->identity.name, str/dex/con/int/wis/cha<->abilities.*, ac<->combat.armorClass, hp_max<->combat.maxHitPoints, hp_current<->combat.hitPoints, class<->class, level<->level, race<->identity.raceOrAncestry, background<->identity.background) + a reverse PATH_TO_SCHEMA_ID. Renders @/features/game-systems/components/CharacterSchemaRenderer.vue (v-model=formModel). Read-only 'Imported from: [badge]' header bound from response.detectedSource (data-testid=imported-from-badge). D&D 5e editable 2014/2024 ruleset <select> shown only when response.ruleset is '2014'/'2024', pre-populated from response.ruleset, amber border/ring + 'Confirm it before saving' note + title tooltip when response.rulesetRequiresConfirmation. requiresReview/unmapped highlight section; extra unmapped fields shown read-only and NEVER submitted. confirm() synthesizes FieldMappingEntry[] ONLY for mapped paths present in mappedFields: each entry { sourceFieldName: <ApplyMapping path> (non-null label, MEDIUM-2), canonicalFieldPath: <path>, value: edited String or seeded fallback }, submits via EXISTING applyFieldMappings (PUT /api/characters/{id}/field-mappings), emits 'confirmed' on success (and 'cancel').
- src/features/characters/components/sourceBadges.ts: SourceBadge type, sourceBadge(detectedSource) resolver with the design's badge colors (PathbuilderTwo orange, DndBeyond* red, Foundry* purple, Roll20 blue, GenericVtt gray, Unknown amber fallback), and SOURCE_OPTIONS (Auto-detect ''=value, PathbuilderTwo, DndBeyondApi, FoundryDnd5e, FoundryPf2e, Roll20, GenericVtt) for the override dropdown. detectedSource values are STRINGS (backend enum .ToString(), no JsonStringEnumConverter — per FEAT-001/003).
- src/features/characters/components/__tests__/ImportCharacterModal.test.ts and ImportReviewPanel.test.ts (13 tests). Modal test stubs ImportReviewPanel + Teleport and mocks @/features/game-systems/api + ../../api; panel test mocks previewCharacterForm and applyFieldMappings. Both drive private methods via (wrapper.vm as unknown as {...}).

FILES MODIFIED:
- src/features/characters/api.ts: ImportCharacterJsonRequest gained gameSystemDefinitionId?:string|null; added DndBeyondUrlImportRequest; UnmappedFieldDto gained requiresReview?:boolean; CharacterFieldReviewDto gained review-scoped gameSystemDefinitionId?/mappedFields?:Record<string,string>/requiresGameSystemSelection?; added SourceImportResponse { detectedSource,confidence,requiresSourceConfirmation,ruleset,rulesetRequiresConfirmation,review }; added importCharacterFromSource(request,{source?,gameSystemDefinitionId?}) -> POST /api/characters/import (?source and ?gameSystemDefinitionId as QUERY params; gameSystem/ruleset blank in body) and importCharacterFromDndBeyondUrl(request) -> POST /api/characters/import/dndbeyond-url. The legacy importCharacterFromJson is unchanged and still used by the store's importCharacterFromJson action.
- src/features/characters/store.ts: added importCharacterFromSource and importCharacterFromDndBeyondUrl actions (loading/error handling; return the SourceImportResponse, no auto-insert since the character is a draft pending review).
- src/features/game-systems/api.ts: added previewCharacterForm(id) -> POST /api/game-systems/{id}/preview-character-form with {} body, returns FormDescriptor (imported from ./types).
- src/features/characters/components/ImportCharacterModal.vue: REWRITTEN into three tabs (Upload File | D&D Beyond URL | PDF). Now self-drives the source-adapter flow via the store (no longer emits a raw 'import' request). Upload File: .json picker -> importCharacterFromSource; detected-source badge (data-testid=detected-source-badge); on requiresSourceConfirmation shows #source-select (SOURCE_OPTIONS, pre-selects detected source unless Unknown) with a Continue button that re-POSTs with ?source; on review.requiresGameSystemSelection lazy-loads listGameSystems() and shows #game-system-select, Continue re-POSTs with the chosen gameSystemDefinitionId AND the previously-selected source (pins the mapper). D&D Beyond URL: #ddb-url input (placeholder https://www.dndbeyond.com/characters/...), help link to /account/sharing, 'unofficial API' disclaimer, Import -> importCharacterFromDndBeyondUrl. PDF tab: informational, points to the existing Import PDF button. Once a response needs no confirmation, renders <ImportReviewPanel :response>; on @confirmed emits 'completed' and resets; @cancel clears the response back to the form. Emits are now 'completed' and 'close' (the old 'import' emit and setErrors expose were removed).
- src/features/characters/CharactersView.vue: dropped importModalRef + handleImport (and the now-unused ImportCharacterJsonRequest import); added handleImportCompleted that closes the modal and refetches the campaign's characters; modal binding changed to @completed=handleImportCompleted (the PDF-button flow on this view is unchanged).

ENVELOPE vs REVIEW BINDING (acceptance #4): source/confidence/ruleset badges + the ruleset dropdown read from response.* (detectedSource, confidence, ruleset, rulesetRequiresConfirmation, requiresSourceConfirmation); the form id, seeded values, and the game-system-selection prompt read from response.review.* (gameSystemDefinitionId, mappedFields, requiresGameSystemSelection). NOTE for integrators: npm install was run in the worktree to populate node_modules (it was empty); dist/ and node_modules/ remain gitignored and were not committed.
